decision_rule: A candidate appliance is eligible only after its installation manual fits the surveyed clear opening, service envelope and fully open operating envelope. Nominal source boxes and rendered front divisions are not installation cavities. Never use countertop segments 307/600/593 mm as usable openings.

checks.model_reference: 600 x 610 mm plan envelope; renderer solid body 840 mm high at z35–875, worktop proxy top860. No continuous worktop or surveyed cavity is saved.
site_measurements: Minimum clear width at front/middle/rear, clear depth excluding hoses/valves and clear height floor-to-underside at all corners
Floor level/levelling range, worktop thickness/support, side panels and moisture barrier
Door sweep to full-open, projecting panel/handle, lower toe-kick interference, basket extension and operator standing space
manufacturer_evidence: Dimensioned installation opening and tolerances, levelling feet range
Door/panel permissible height, thickness and mass; fixed/sliding hinge system and toe-kick sweep
Open door depth, fully extended racks, service rear/side zones, inlet/drain bend radii and power isolation
checks.pass_rule: All measured minimum clear dimensions satisfy the exact manual; mockup opens door and both baskets without collision or blocking the escape/service route.

checks.model_reference: West1500 x600 counter and600 x400 hob envelope. Oven is reserved in name only; no fitted oven object, cutout or under-hob drawer cavity exists.
site_measurements: Actual worktop material/thickness, cutout support rails and clear usable counter width/depth
Distances from burner/pan support to combustible finishes, upper fronts, profile and hood
Service cavity, electrical/gas connections, ventilation and extraction path
manufacturer_evidence: Exact hob cutout drawing, minimum edge/web clearances and underside depth
Chosen eventual oven envelope/open-door depth and required ventilation; compatibility with hob
Gas isolation and approved connection access; heat shielding and prohibited nearby materials
checks.pass_rule: Hob and oven manuals share a feasible supported cutout/service arrangement with all heat clearances; no under-hob drawers assumed.

checks.model_reference: Legacy hood bounds z1550–2330; saved upper z1480–2180. About676 mm above nominal874 hob reference is not a certified burner-to-hood clearance.
site_measurements: Actual cooking support height, hood underside/width/depth and filter-removal envelope
Duct diameter, bend count/radii, route, wall penetration, discharge location and available makeup air
Mounting substrate and hood/upper/profile heat and access separation
manufacturer_evidence: Gas/electric minimum and maximum installation heights, capture width and mounting loads
Duct size/allowed routing, noise/flow performance under actual resistance; recirculation limitations if relevant
Independent cleanable downward task light, removable filter/optics and declared lamp/driver service access
checks.pass_rule: Licensed installer confirms manufacturer height/routing and maintenance access; task-light concept is a capability requirement, not a hood SKU or wattage.

checks.model_reference: Exposed600 x610 plan envelope; rendered top850. No hidden cabinet panel or approved installation enclosure.
site_measurements: Clear width/depth/height including hose loops, vibration clearance and level floor
Full-open machine door, laundry loading stance and withdrawable forward service path
Reachable shutoff, waste connection, plug isolation and leak inspection/drain protection
manufacturer_evidence: Body plus fittings depth, anti-vibration and ventilation clearances
Hinge side, maximum door projection and removal procedure
Hose length/bend radius, drain standpipe height, water pressure, transport bolt removal and electrical protection
checks.pass_rule: Machine can operate, ventilate and be removed without dismantling saved cabinetry or obstructing the service door. Concealment remains HOLD.

checks.model_reference: Sink550 x400 over600 x610 base; bowl/cutout/trap geometry and clear internal cabinet are not resolved. Generic top drawer-looking front is not storage evidence.
site_measurements: Bowl and clips envelope, tap/handle swing and backsplash clearance
Trap outlet fall, service pipe routes and dishwasher hose/high-loop arrangement per local requirements
Accessible shutoffs, removable trap and leak inspection; cleaning cupboard clear shelves and door opening
manufacturer_evidence: Sink cutout/template and cabinet minimum; sealing instructions
Tap hole/connection and waste-kit dimensions
Dishwasher drain connection/backflow requirements; service maintenance access
checks.pass_rule: Full-scale service mockup fits without trapping valves, waste, hoses or electrical isolation. Cleaning supplies stored separately and safely; no drawer obstructs wet services.

checks.model_reference: Fridge650 x650 source envelope; renderer high1955 with projecting handles. Door source segments about720 and678 mm are model lengths, not certified clear access widths.
site_measurements: Refrigerator intake/exhaust gaps and adjacent18 mm end panel
Actual refrigerator door hinge/angle, drawer and bin withdrawal, handle projection
Kitchen entrance and service door jamb/hinge/leaf sweeps, actual clear widths and appliance delivery route
manufacturer_evidence: Required opening angle for bin/drawer removal, side clearance at hinge and door-open depth
Ventilation scheme and integrated fascia compatibility
Delivery/unpacking dimensions and service pull-out path
checks.pass_rule: Fridge, entrance and service doors work in all intended states with accessible handles and unobstructed escape route. Saved door geometry remains unchanged.

checks.model_reference: Closed-object edges can identify test areas; they cannot confirm two-person operation. Room metric geometry is image-inferred.
site_measurements: Clear passage with dishwasher door and lower basket open while another person reaches sink
Washer loading/withdrawal while service door operates
Cook stance at hob with second person passing to fridge/entrance, including pan handles
manufacturer_evidence: Dimensioned door/basket/service envelopes of shortlisted eventual products
checks.pass_rule: Tape out surveyed envelopes at full scale; two actual users demonstrate passing and escape with appliances/doors open. Record bottleneck dimensions and collisions; agree an operating sequence if simultaneous use is infeasible.

site_measurements: Carcass internal clear widths/depths, panel thickness, hinge/handle sweeps and shelf capacity
Upper fixing substrate/loads, reachable handles and safe maintenance access to2180 cabinet tops
Corner opening/hardware envelope and actual stored-item list
manufacturer_evidence: Hinge/slide/handle templates and loading data; corner hardware full sweep
Washable matte front/edge samples, stain/heat/moisture tests and fixing details
checks.pass_rule: Issue a signed as-built front/hinge/shelf schedule after measured fit. Generic3-way upper seams and307/600/593 countertop reservations confer no usable aperture.

site_measurements: Profile/diffuser location from actual cabinet front, screw fixing zones, cable/driver access and cleaning reach
Worktop and hood-zone finish extents, wall flatness, corner/end returns, sockets and sealed joint widths
Night worktop/hob illumination with actual optics and standing users; reflected/direct glare from entrance and prep position
manufacturer_evidence: Photometric distribution, colour consistency/CRI, dimming/flicker and moisture/heat rating
Accessible replaceable driver/optics, certified electrical design and manufacturer hood light controls
Finish thermal/moisture compatibility, substrate preparation, adhesive/sealant compatibility and movement tolerances
checks.pass_rule: Separate controllable task and general lighting; measure real illuminance and verify glare/shadow performance on site. Render intensities are arbitrary visual parameters, not lux/watts/wiring approval.
